content:
- Overestimate prices after recent sentiment spikes (especially when sentiment > 0.23), especially in the 10-15 day horizon.
- Underestimate prices when sentiment is consistently negative (sentiment < -0.11) over the last 5-7 days.
- Avoid overreacting to short-term sentiment shifts; model should not overshoot by >5% in 3-5 day horizon unless sentiment is strongly bullish.
- Mean-reversion bias: if forecast is >10% above recent 7-day average, reduce by 1-2% per day until convergence.
- Lag correction: if true outcome is >10% above forecast at day 1, adjust next 3 days downward by 0.5-1% per day.
- Horizon-specific: 30-day forecasts should not exceed 15% above 30-day moving average unless sentiment is strongly bullish and sustained.
